scope: Independent Ring0.17.14 -> AWS-LC1.18.1 audit Ed25519 compatibility investigation; scratch only
required_guards: Before UnparsedPublicKey verification, require public_key.len()==32 in BOTH ExternalSealSigner and InMemoryEd25519Signer. Otherwise AWS parses SPKI DER and widens the API beyond existing raw32 semantics. Return Ok(false) on wrong lengths, preserving existing tamper-verdict behavior rather than constructor/service failure.

Explicit signature.len()==64 is a useful fixed wire-contract guard; tested backends already reject malformed lengths. Preserve unknown anchor=false, trusted local anchor lookup, exact message bytes, key_ref semantics and signature/hash serialization.

Do not restore malformed/noncanonical public-key acceptance via bespoke curve code or a permissive verifier. Document stricter AWS rejection. Before production migration, actual pinned historical anchors/seals must verify; this experiment uses public/synthetic fixtures, not customer seal history.
compatibility_limits: All11 constructed narrowing cases use noncanonical/invalid-sign-bit encodings of low-order public keys and S=0; these are not normally generated Ed25519 public keys. Ordinary old keys/signatures and cross-generation PKCS8 matched. This does not prove equivalence for every possible input.
Six low-order cases are accepted by both libraries; therefore this change must not claim new complete torsion rejection. Trust-anchor custody/quality remains required.

AWS generate_pkcs8 uses its own CSPRNG and ignores supplied SecureRandom for compatibility; existing app only supplies SystemRandom, so do not rely on externally injected RNG determinism. Both implementations generated/imported PKCS8v2 successfully in32 rounds.
No FIPS claim. No actual customer data scan, production mutation, Linux release, or repository dependency change was performed.

corpus.additional_matrix: 10 hand-constructed compressed points (canonical y0,identity,y=p-1;noncanonical y=p,y=p+1 and toggled sign bits),10R values,2scalars(0,L),2messages =400; comparative observations, not independently proven valid-signature oracle.
